title: Fix World Continent LOD Teal Map
description: World and continent LOD shows only teal water until zooming in. Fix vector tile zoom and colored coastline fallback.
summary: Fixed world/continent LOD showing only teal water: vector tile zoom now uses span-based detail (z3 at world, z5 at continent) instead of being capped by coarse raster z0/z1. Colored coastline mode falls back to land backdrop + water polygons when countries layer is absent. Repaired broken compile state (TileSeamCull removal, TILE_INTERIOR_INSET, pub mvt_point_on_tile_bbox_edge). Added tests and rebuilt WASM.
